title: ChromaDB anonymized telemetry is on
explanation: chromadb before 1.5.4 sends anonymized product telemetry (PostHog) by default. It's off only when ANONYMIZED_TELEMETRY is False in the environment or anonymized_telemetry=False is passed in client Settings. From 1.5.3 (yanked; 1.5.4 is the first available release) the PostHog client is a no-op and posthog is no longer a dependency, so newer versions don't match.

evidence.detail: chromadb 1.5.2 installed, in affected range <1.5.4; not disabled in the image (none of ANONYMIZED_TELEMETRY=0|false|no|off)

fix: Upgrade chromadb to 1.5.4 or later, or set ANONYMIZED_TELEMETRY=False in the image environment.
